verdict.summary: The stream-write hardening is coherent and complete as scoped. Pending output streams prevent premature completion; import/remove batch synchronously with explicit error termination and preserve the documented incremental semantics; invalid graph terms are rejected before matching, closing the Variable-as-wildcard destructive case. The tests exercise the real adapter/store path, observe state inside completion handlers, count actual delta calls, cover constructor and per-call chunk sizes, source errors, named/default graph addressing, and invalid destructive inputs. The exported option type and public skill documentation are updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found.
